bugs.desc: evolve() judged the last sampled generation as the final state: with generations=150, sample_every=100 the silencing verdict and design advice were computed at gen 100 (knockout 0.084, 'genetically stable') while the true gen-150 endpoint was silenced (knockout 0.864); generations < sample_every crashed IndexError on the empty history. Now the true endpoint is always snapshotted and judged.

evolve() fitness-proportional selection left `child` unassigned when a draw exceeded the cumulative fitness sum (floating-point undershoot of 1.0): UnboundLocalError on the first offspring, silent reuse of the previously selected parent afterwards. Now bisect with a clamp to the last individual; seeded histories byte-identical for 3 seeds.

evolve() had no parameter validation: pop_size=0 crashed ZeroDivisionError, mutation_rate=-1.0 silently disabled mutation, mutation_rate x genes > 1 silently saturated the single-mutation-per-offspring model, generations=0 crashed IndexError. All now informative ValueErrors.

simulate_evolution_experiment and simulate_competition silently resolved uncovered generations to the last-listed environment (order-dependent): a schedule covering only [0,50) labeled generations 50-200 'growth', and a [50,100) gap inherited the last-listed 'production'. Now full-coverage validation raises ValueError naming the first uncovered generation; default schedules extend past the endpoint.

_evo_diagnostics reported censored events as measurements: failure_onset_generation, intact_half_life_generation and the three detection generations returned the final sampled generation when the event never occurred (intact fraction 0.994, no failure), contradicting the top-level failure_onset_generation=None in the same result. Now None, consistent with the failure_observed flag.

simulate_evolution_experiment silently capped the per-class mutation flux at mu=min(0.2, mutation_rate x genes): 30 genes at 0.01 intended flux 0.30 but applied 0.20 with no flag. Now an explicit ValueError at the model-capacity bound.
